description: POSTS a message into a LIVE chat — a customer-visible reply (type "message") or an internal private note (type "private"). Set `agent` (agent id) for agent messages; omit it for customer messages. HelpCrunch REST: POST /messages.

agent.description: Agent id — required for agent messages; omit for customer messages.

chat.description: The chat id to post the message into.

markdown_text.description: Optional markdown version of the message (→ markdownText).

name: helpcrunch_create_message
title: Create message
